Sharewear Clothing Scheme

Sharewear Clothing Scheme provides free, good quality clothing to people experiencing hardship in Nottingham. The service operates via a referral system, allowing clients to choose clothing for themselves and their families.

Nottingham, United KingdomFree with eligibilityChecked 2026-08-14

Confirm before you go. Drop-in sessions are Wednesdays 10:00 - 15:30 only. A referral form from a support worker is required before visiting. Photo ID may be requested.
